record.question: Under Rule 27(1) of GFR 2017, when does a sanction, rule or order come into force?
options: Only on the date specified in the accompanying Delegation of Financial Power Rules
From the date of its issue, unless any other date from which they shall come into force is specified therein
After final approval by the Drawing and Disbursing Officer
From the beginning of the next financial year
record.explanation: Selected alternative matches the cited paper and standard rule.
